name: Pomodoro
description: A focus session like Windows Focus: pick the total minutes, optionally split into 22-33 min focus blocks with 5 min breaks, then follow the ring. Breaks and focus periods start on their own. Pause, skip, add 5 minutes, a sound as a break starts and ends, a toast at each phase change and a daily tally of focus minutes. Optional webcam timelapse of the whole session (replaces Study Time-Lapse). Survives restarts.
author: AmineChr54
changelog: Breaks and focus periods start on their own again (the old switch could be stuck off since 1.x). A soft chime as a break starts and a brighter one as it ends. The timelapse reopens the camera when it stops answering instead of ending.

autoContinue.label: Start breaks and focus periods automatically
autoContinue.hint: Off: the session waits for you at each break and focus period.

sound.label: Play a sound when a break starts and ends
sound.hint: A soft chime as a break starts, a brighter one as it ends. The phase toast then stays quiet.

notify.label: Notify at each phase change
notify.hint: Also set Notifications to On (or Default with notifications allowed in General) for this widget in Settings.
